name: January, together
lede: Os lands in Salvador on 28 December for New Year with friends. Around the 9th we meet somewhere new to both of us, and the two weeks after that are ours: a city to walk, some nature and animals, and dry weather. Three options, none decided.
blurb: Two weeks of us from around 9 January, somewhere new and dry. Chile, Colombia, or Buenos Aires and Uruguay: a city and some nature, on a modest budget.
description: Two weeks together in January 2027, still undecided: Valparaíso and the Elqui Valley, Medellín and the coffee region, or Buenos Aires and Uruguay.
